not_computable: VIX term structure (no India VIX futures / VIX3M series in the store)
FII daily flows (not in the store; midcap-vs-Nifty relative strength used as the risk-appetite proxy)
summary.multiple_comparisons_note: 46 single gates and 95 pairs tested; at a 5% false-positive rate ~2 single gates would pass one half by luck. Promotion requires both halves and all three strategies, which cuts that sharply but not to zero; treat non-robust promotions as suggestive.

breadth50_hysteresis.definition: off below 40%, back on only above 50%

breadth50_sustained.definition: off only after 10 straight sessions below 50%

vix_z60_low.definition: VIX z-score vs 60d below H1 median

vrp_high.definition: VIX minus 20d realised vol above H1 median

range20_low.definition: Nifty 20d high-low range below H1 median

mcclellan_sum_rising.definition: summation index above its value 5 sessions ago

not_expiry_week.definition: signal not in F&O expiry week

rvol20_not_high.definition: Nifty 20d realised vol below H1 75th pct

dispersion_low.definition: 20d avg cross-sectional dispersion below H1 median

rvol60_not_high.definition: Nifty 60d realised vol below H1 75th pct

no_bear_rebound.definition: NOT (Nifty >10% off high AND up >5% in 20d)
